props.heading: Corrections and Clarifications
props.description: Recent corrections to previously published content

props.text: **Original:** The company reported quarterly revenue of $4.2 billion, up 12% year over year.
**Corrected:** The company reported quarterly revenue of $4.02 billion, up 9% year over year.

props.title: Reason
props.description: Figures were transposed from a preliminary earnings table.

props.text: **Original:** The new transit line will open in fall 2026 and serve 40,000 riders daily.
**Corrected:** The new transit line will open in spring 2026 and serve an estimated 14,000 riders daily.

props.title: Reason
props.description: The original schedule and ridership figures were from an outdated city proposal.

props.text: **Original:** The study involved 1,200 participants across six countries.
**Corrected:** The study involved 1,020 participants across four countries.

props.title: Reason
props.description: The participant count and country total were misreported in the initial summary.
